M-AREA-SLIDER-WIDGET.Purpose: Controlled two-axis slider drawing a value handle and translating transformed pointer drags into owner-authoritative Value proposals.

Scope.SCP-IN-001: AreaSlider Value, XRange, YRange, OnValueChange, Disabled, Tooltip, Label and LabelColor.
Scope.SCP-IN-002: Local-coordinate drag mapping, clamp and labeled handle drawing.
Scope.SCP-OUT-001: Global pointer capture, event dispatch and layout snapshots — owned by existing runtime modules.

Requirements.REQ-001: MouseDown starts own drag only when enabled, left-button and inside local layout bounds after TransformService.TryToLocal.
Requirements.REQ-002: During active drag, mouse positions normalize independently to XRange and reversed YRange, clamped to [0,1] before interpolation.
Requirements.REQ-003: Proposals call OnValueChange only when enabled and either component differs from authoritative Value; the component never writes Value itself.
Requirements.REQ-004: Drag state is local to the widget instance and is cleared on disabled rendering, mouse release, leave and unmount.
Requirements.REQ-005: Default preferred layout is 100 by 100; explicitly supplied dimensions and Flexbox constraints are retained.

Inputs.IN-001: Vector2 Value, XRange/YRange, enabled state and FlexEvent mouse input.

SideEffects.EFF-001: Native drawing, local drag-state mutation and changed-input callback.
